news.h: Vikings to start QB Carson Wentz against Bills with Kyler Murray ruled out
news.d: Vikings quarterback Carson Wentz will start Monday night's game against the Buffalo Bills with Kyler Murray ruled out with a hamstring injury.

news.h: Josh Allen-produced short doc on Buffalo storm gets release date, trailer
news.d: The short documentary on the once-in-a-generation Buffalo blizzard will be released on Nov. 24.

news.h: Josh Allen's halftime words fuel Bills' 2nd-half surge in win over Ravens
news.d: QB Josh Allen said the Bills "didn't play up to our standard" in the first half Sunday against the Ravens -- and delivered a halftime message to his teammates that essentially said "we're way better than this."

news.h: Bills cruise in 2nd half to 36-10 win over Ravens, who lose QBs Jackson and Huntley to injuries
news.d: — With Josh Allen at quarterback, anything seems possible for the Buffalo Bills — including overcoming a sloppy first half.

news.h: Inside Justin Jefferson's miraculous catch for Vikings versus Bills in 2022
news.d: In 2022 against the Bills, Jefferson leaped up and came down with one of "the greatest catches of all time."

news.h: Justin Jefferson high on Vikings' offensive potential, doesn't want to waste it
news.d: Speaking for the first time since his frustrations overflowed in Detroit, Justin Jefferson said of the Vikings' offense: "We've got to figure out that answer and figure it out fast."

news.h: Vikings acknowledge Justin Jefferson's frustration: Must get him the ball
news.d: Justin Jefferson declined to speak with reporters after Sunday's loss, and coach Kevin O'Connell and QB Kyler Murray acknowledged the receiver's disposition.
